label: K-Breathe
description: Displays live breathing data from the Tymewear VitalPro sensor on your Karoo. Includes VE, breathing rate, tidal volume, mobilization index, VE graph and time-in-zones fields with FIT recording, plus an opt-in Beta that learns your own ventilation baseline and shows how today differs from it.
releaseNotes: Fixes silent corruption of recorded breathing data (previous versions wrote a frozen or zero value for most of every ride after a strap dropout), a connection watchdog that could only fire once, and Bluetooth scans being refused by Android without any log. Live fields now show -- when the strap drops instead of a stale number. NEW (Beta, OFF by default): Ventilatory State - learns your normal ventilation at each power and shows today's deviation from it, today's VT1 power, and breathing-rate drift. Enable under Ventilatory State (Beta) in the app; requires a paired power meter; the first two rides calibrate and show 'cal', ride three onwards shows values. Settings are preserved on upgrade.
